label: Smooth (EMA)
author: conky-studio
description: Exponential moving average — tames jittery sensors. Unique Slot per instance so parallel smoothers do not share state.

properties.label: Alpha
properties.help: 1 = no smoothing. Smaller = heavier lag. 0.15-0.3 is a good start for CPU/net.

properties.label: Slot
properties.help: Unique integer per Smooth node (1, 2, 3...). Shared slots share memory.
